title: Separate live agent streaming, tool-status, stop-signal, and TTS feedback boundaries
description: AstrBot's agent run utility coordinates streaming chunks, tool-call status messages, stop signals, final chain extraction, and optional TTS/live-agent feedback. Rust should keep this feedback orchestration separate from the agent runner core, RespondStage, and provider streaming parsers.

files.change: Build status events outside provider streaming and pipeline response delivery.
Keep user stop/cancel checks out of the provider adapter and RespondStage.
Route optional TTS streaming through a feedback boundary instead of embedding it in the agent runner loop.

criteria: Provider streaming parsers emit chunks but do not build user-facing status messages.
RespondStage remains final delivery and does not own live-agent orchestration.
TTS feedback can be enabled or disabled without changing core agent execution.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test --workspace && cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings
